_comment: Weighing machine v0 worked example: the dwelling-age 101+ manual-review alert, priced for removal. Every value carries source + confidence + range. Sources: Zero Alerts README (alert-north-star/README.md), What Must Be True v4 (appendix/what-must-be-true.html), ~/mockups/damr-postbind-uarnoe/{ANALYSIS,DEEPDIVE}-2026-08-16.md, Two Houses artifact 443f560b, scratch-darren 2026-08-noc-impact-inde-agent. Recipes: consult-the-book data-recipes.md, Metabase db 235.

alert.name: Dwelling age 101+ manual review
alert.description: Homes over 100 years old cannot bind until an underwriter reviews them. First and most common blocking alert. Per 100 age-alert-only quotes, ~63 die with nobody ever looking and ~16 bind.
notes: Cohort layering assumes the same population applies after removal; alerts also deter bad risks, so every cost line here is a floor, not an estimate (Zero Alerts README s7).
Published v0 ledger this config must reproduce: What Must Be True v4 s2 and Zero Alerts README s4.

estimator.comparison: the 91-100 year old homes that never had the alert (the just-under twin), layered onto the 101+ funnel; risk gradient projection keeps the age gap honest (+22.8%/decade)
estimator.notes: Default method. Blind to who would start submitting once the alert is gone, so every cost line is a floor. Robustness checks when it matters: pre-alert era and the boundary slice (REQUIREMENTS.md, Estimation methods).

forced_reviews_per_month.source: What Must Be True v4 s1 / Zero Alerts README s4: ~2,200 forced UW reviews per month eliminated by removal.
forced_reviews_per_month.recipe: db 235: eventstore underwriting_review_note submissions joined to dbt.ipod_smga_uw_alerts_per_quote_version at the submitted (quote_id, quote_version), age-family tagged (data-recipes.md, 'UW touches per alert family').

current_binds_per_month.source: ANALYSIS-2026-08-16.md (~/mockups/damr-postbind-uarnoe): 'the current ~850 DAMR-only binds/mo'. Range is a +-50 hand bracket.
current_binds_per_month.recipe: db 235: dbt.ipod_standard_mga_raw_policy_info, DAMR-only NB cohort, quote_issued_timestamp not null (data-recipes.md, 'DAMR control groups').

binds_gained_per_month.source: Zero Alerts README s4 / Two Houses (artifact 443f560b): 91-100 twin layered onto the 101+ funnel. Pinned, not derived: v0's counting half already ran by hand. Top-7-states cut = +107.
binds_gained_per_month.recipe: db 235 funnel-twin recipe (data-recipes.md 2026-08-13): DAMR-only 101+ bind 15.1% vs just-under 0-alert 14.4% vs under-91 0-alert 18.0%, Jan-May 2026.

reviewed_noc_per_100_bound_90d.denominator: per 100 bound policies of the reviewed 101+ (DAMR) cohort, inspection-lane NOCs, first 90 days after bind
reviewed_noc_per_100_bound_90d.source: Zero Alerts README s6b: 192 NOCs / 4,244 bound. Range = Byar approximate 95% CI on the count.
reviewed_noc_per_100_bound_90d.recipe: db 235 snapshots dbt_dev.damr_uarnoe_*_20260816, MB cards 142904-142907 (collection 6787); cancellation rows with cancellation_reason='Inspection' (data-recipes.md, 'Post-bind UAR/NOE census').

twin_noc_per_100_bound_90d.denominator: per 100 bound policies of the un-reviewed 91-100 just-under twin, inspection-lane NOCs, first 90 days after bind
twin_noc_per_100_bound_90d.source: Zero Alerts README s6b: 79 NOCs / 1,223 bound. Range = Byar approximate 95% CI. This is a FLOOR for true un-reviewed 101+ (see unreviewed_noc_projection_per_100).

unreviewed_noc_projection_per_100.denominator: per 100 bound policies, projected true un-reviewed 101+ book, inspection-lane NOCs, 90 days
unreviewed_noc_projection_per_100.source: Two Houses artifact 443f560b s2: NOC ramps +22.8%/decade of dwelling age; the 101+ book averages 117 years, 16 past the twin; trend projection 7-11 per 100. Scenario input, not the headline.
unreviewed_noc_projection_per_100.recipe: db 235 age-gradient re-band of dbt_dev.damr_uarnoe_{cohort,final}_20260816 (data-recipes.md, 'No-alert age gradient'); Poisson log-linear slope +22.8%/decade [19.9-25.7].

reviewed_noe_per_100_bound_90d.denominator: per 100 bound policies of the reviewed 101+ (DAMR) cohort, UW-initiated corrective endorsements, first 90 days
reviewed_noe_per_100_bound_90d.source: Zero Alerts README s6b / ANALYSIS-2026-08-16.md: 164 / 4,244 bound. Range = Byar approximate 95% CI.
reviewed_noe_per_100_bound_90d.recipe: db 235: f_ev_class IN ('attribute_correction','exclusion_change') AND f_actor_class='uw' on dbt_dev.damr_uarnoe_final_20260816 (data-recipes.md).

twin_noe_per_100_bound_90d.denominator: per 100 bound policies of the un-reviewed 91-100 twin, UW-initiated corrective endorsements, first 90 days
twin_noe_per_100_bound_90d.source: Zero Alerts README s6b / ANALYSIS-2026-08-16.md: 92 / 1,223 bound (1.95x the reviewed book). Range = Byar approximate 95% CI.

levers_addressable_share_of_noc_gap.unit: share of the twin-minus-reviewed NOC gap the levers can address
levers_addressable_share_of_noc_gap.source: ANALYSIS-2026-08-16.md sub-reason table: Cond-General + Liability + Roof + Ineligible gaps sum to 1.48 of the 1.94 per-100 NOC gap (76%); these are the categories pre-fill, roof retargeting, and attestations can reach. Range is a hand bracket. Drives the after-the-levers scenario caveat.
levers_addressable_share_of_noc_gap.recipe: db 235: NOC sub-reason join tap_veruna.wt_insurance_policy__c.steadily_uw_cancellation_reason__c on the damr_uarnoe snapshots (data-recipes.md).

foregone_uw_correction_premium_per_100_b.denominator: per 100 bound policies, bound-only premium added by UW six-field corrections, never recovered at renewal
foregone_uw_correction_premium_per_100_b.source: DEEPDIVE-2026-08-16.md cents correction: bound-only $154,542 over the cohort window -> $3,034 per 100 bound. Deliberately bound-only (the larger all-approved figure mostly never binds). UW fixes raise price 3.4x more often than they lower it.
foregone_uw_correction_premium_per_100_b.recipe: db 235: dbt_dev.damr_prem_flags_20260807 (values are in CENTS, the classic trap) joined to bind outcomes (data-recipes.md, 'Premium join').

year1_premium_usd.source: UNPRICED. What Must Be True v4: bind weight = year-one premium only so far; LTV (retention, compounding GWP, segment loss cost) is the finance/actuarial ask. The grid is an illustrative placeholder, replace with finance's number.

cure_rate.source: scratch-darren 2026-08-noc-impact-inde-agent REPORT.md v8 (2026-08-19): 74% of NOCs cure, stable 2024 to 2025. n=5,892 NOC'd policies from 2025H1 binds; cure = never UW-cancelled to date, net of reinstatement. NOTE the definition: the uar-noc-reasons project uses a different 5-day rule; do not net its cancel rates against this.
cure_rate.recipe: scratch-darren repo, data/operating_point.csv + analysis/operating_point.py; tradeoff.py constant C0.

cured_agent_book_loss_pct.unit: % of that agent's next-year binds, per cured NOC (book basis)
cured_agent_book_loss_pct.source: scratch-darren v8 REPORT.md: 0 (book-level, undetectable at any observed dose) to -2.1% per event (within-agent panel, p<.001, 182,206 agent-months). This config uses the BOOK basis; point = midpoint of the band. Competing values in circulation: panel -2.1%/event, and Darren's emails use 3-7% (self-labeled directional) - the choice moves his 8/23 breakeven from ~12 to ~19-23 of 55 notices. See cure_price_basis.

uncured_agent_book_loss_pct.unit: % of that agent's next-year binds, per cancellation (dose reading)
uncured_agent_book_loss_pct.source: scratch-darren v8 REPORT.md:38, a published ladder, not early data: agents whose book is 5-25% cancelled produce at 0.77-0.82 of matched controls (0.43 at 50% of book). The front-loading is in DOSE (the first meaningful cancellation does most of the damage), NOT in time: the monthly path is flat for 12+ months, a recurring annual flow while the relationship stays broken (REPORT.md:30,53,144). The within-agent per-event price is -3.0%/event (n=6,411). v0 treats -20% as level per event, which overstates agents with several NOCs.

agent_next_year_binds.source: UNPRICED. Needed to convert the per-NOC %-of-book loss into binds. Pull the real distribution of binds per producing agent before trusting any row; grid is illustrative.

customer_side_usd.source: UNPRICED. Refunded premium + sunk acquisition cost per cancelled policy (What Must Be True v4: 'still unpriced: the customer side').

customer_premium_relief_usd.source: ANALYSIS-2026-08-16.md: UW corrective NOEs are premium-neutral, ~$0 relief to the customer; DEEPDIVE catch-count: coverage carved with <$10 relief on 6.8% of unreviewed vs 3.3% reviewed policies.

experience_cost_usd.source: UNPRICED. The removed-coverage / bait-and-switch side (LaNae 8/18: NOC and NOE sit in the same category; the deal changed after close). Grid is illustrative.

agent_book_loss_pct.unit: % of that agent's next-year binds, per NOE event
agent_book_loss_pct.source: scratch-darren v8 REPORT.md:110-117, the agent-side NOE price: an NOE on a policy that stays ok costs -0.4% (p=.66, not significant); an NOE on a policy later cancelled costs -4.8% (p=.009); blended ~ -1.3% of next-12m binds per event (vs -2.4% for a NOC event). Range = the ok/cancelled bracket, not a CI.

labor_usd_per_review.source: UW expense model anchors: UW labor $1.50/quote and $6.82/bound. Our derivation, flagged as an assumption: $1.50 x ~64.4k NB quotes/mo ~= $97k/mo and $6.82 x ~10.5k bound/mo ~= $72k/mo bracket the labor pool; divided by ~16.3k referral reviews/mo -> $4.4-5.9 per review; band widened to $4.5-7.5. The pool-to-review division is ours, not the expense model's.
labor_usd_per_review.recipe: volumes: data-recipes.md 'Verified volumes' (NB 64.4k created / 10.5k bound / 16,269 referral submissions per month).

loss_join_usd.source: MISSING ENTIRELY. No method ties an alert to realized losses; loss ratio lands ~1 year later. Plan (What Must Be True v4 s5): actuarial backtest of the twin's on-book losses against the reviewed 101+ book. The deepest price tag.

validation._comment: The published v0 ledger (What Must Be True v4 s2 / Zero Alerts README s4). tests/test_dwelling_age_v0.py asserts the machine reproduces it within tolerance. Note on NOEs: the hand ledger's +30 counted only the existing book's rate shift (850 x 3.66/100 ~= 31); the machine also reports the coherent total including new-bind NOEs (~+40).
